scripts.test: cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 --features wasm-test && node washm.js test
scripts.build: cargo build -p washm --release --target wasm32-wasip1 && echo wasm-strip && npx wasm-strip target/wasm32-wasip1/release/washm.wasm && echo wasm-opt && npx wasm-opt --enable-bulk-memory -Oz target/wasm32-wasip1/release/washm.wasm -o ./washm.wasm
